change: Record the first account-fact ingestion exception and reject subsequent add() and result() calls, chained to the original cause. Successful result() calls remain non-finalizing, so valid incremental accumulation behavior is preserved.
regression: A deterministic finite-equity sequence doubles from 1e-100 until compounded path overflow occurs after the streaming statistics have begun updating. The regression confirms the original overflow, then confirms both reuse and report finalization fail closed.
